item.tib: drag sngags gsang ba'i spu gri las dbang mchog byin rlabs gter ldan
item.coloph: ces kyi stag la me 'bar gyi gsang dbang 'di ni/ rtogs ldan rin po che bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi bka' gter phab dgos kyi gsung non dang*/ nye ba gter grogs dbang mo dang mchog spral tshul khrims dang rgyal bzang dpon po sangs rgyas dang khod po sprul sku skal bzang rgyal mtshan sogs kyis bskul ngor dang/ khyad par spyi bon (dbon) nor bu rgyal mtshan gyis gal chen nan bskul lhag rig (lha reg) rin 'khor gyis brten (rten) 'brel mtshon te phul bzhin/ gsang sngags gling pas zab gter rin po che'i brda' ris bod yig tu phab cing yi ge pa ni dngos slob g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pa'o//
